generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidder end
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees as per e-portal
The tender is of two cover system
The original documents should be produced for verification at any stage of tender process as and when sought for, failing which, the bids are liable for disqualification
Rates shall be quoted in Tender Schedule-B (Financial Bid) in the website itself
For those tenderers whose Technical bids satisfy the eligibility criteria and who has furnished all the necessary documents, only their financial Bids will be opened
The tender document is part and parcel of the agreement
Conditional tenders will not be accepted

KPCL reserves the right to verify any information/documents furnished by the tenderer should the circumstances so warrant. In case the information or the documents furnished are found to be incorrect/false or invalid then the EMD furnished by such tenderer shall be forfeited. The registration of such tenderer shall also be cancelled
Right to reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons rests with the accepting authority
The successful bidders shall give an undertaking that they would abide by the provisions of the Employee Provident Fund Act
The contractor shall obtain insurance coverage for all the workers working in this area

The bidder shall quote his rates exclusive of GST but inclusive of all applicable taxes), levies, duties and Cess, building worker welfare Cess (if applicable) etc., as per the latest GOK and Government of India prevailing as on the date of NIT
The Bidder shall quote his rates inclusive of PF as per the applicable rates as issued by the PF Department from time to time.

The bidder should take into account the prevailing royalty charges while quoting their rates and submit the Material Dispatch Permit (MDP) receipt, if not submitted penalty shall be charged as per the joint secretary, Energy Department letter no. Energy26 PPT 2022 dtd: 26.04.2022
KPCL shall recover the Income tax etc., at the prevailing applicable rates

The successful bidder should strictly adhere & ensure the minimum wages Act to the labours prevailing as per the Govt. rules & regulations. The bidder should maintain register of labour deployed and wages paid for the workers and shall produce the documents whenever called for by the competent authority and remittance towards PF shall commensurate with the labour component for the work involved
Contractor should have independents PF Code. The Contractor shall remit PF of labourers to contractors permanent PF code Number only and Not to the KPCL PF Sub Code
In case the dates notified above are declared as holiday, the immediate next working day shall be reckoned
If the contractor makes any alterations in the conditions of the contract or puts any condition of his own, such tenders are liable for rejection
Further details of the work can be obtained in the office of the Executive Engineer (RTM), KPCL, RTPS, Shaktinagar - 584170, during office hours
The tender Notification along with Blank Tender Form will be accessible in the e-procurement website (www.kppp.karnataka.gov.in).
Aspiring Bidders/Contractors who have not obtained the user ID and Password for participating in e-procurement may now obtain the same from the website www.kppp.karnataka.gov.in
Corrigendum/modification/corrections, if any, will be published in the website only
In case the agency fails to execute the work properly, engineer may entrust the work to the other agency at the cost and risk of original agency
All labourers Police verification is to be carried out by the contractor & same to besubmitted for gate passes and cost is also to be borne by the contractor

In case of death of a contractor after executing the agreement/ commencement of the work, his legal heir (to be intimated at the time of execution of agreement by the successful contractor), if any eligible registered contractor and willing, can execute the complete the work at the accepted tender rates irrespective of the cost of the work after obtaining approval competent authority
The tender shall be valid for 180 days from the last date of submission of bid

The Security deposit (CPG) from the successful bidder for an amount equivalent to 5% of the contract price shall be deducted in every running bill. However, in case of first & final bill the entire security deposit (CPG) will be deducted from the final bill of the successful bidder. The deducted contract performance guarantee (CPG) shall be refunded only after the satisfactory completion of total contract period. The work Performance shall be of Twelve (12) Months after completing the work. The total contract period is 16 Months (i.e. 4 Months completion period & 12 Months Guarantee performance period).

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder should have satisfactorily completed as a prime contractor (at least 90% of the contract value) At least one Civil Construction work of value not less than Rs. 7.967 Lakhs (inclusive of GST) in the preceeding Five financial years (i.e 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). The certificate issued by the Competent Authority not below the rank of Chief Engineer in case of KPCLworks and not below the rank of Executive Engineer and equivalent in case of other Government Organizations is to be uploaded in the Technical bid. (Work done of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of financial year 2026-27).

Tenderers who meet the specified minimum qualifying criteria, will only be qualified, if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. The available tender capacity will be calculated as under. Tender capacity: (A x N x 5 - B), where, A - Maximum value of works executed in any one year during the last five years (updated to 2026-27 price level) taking into account the completed as well as works in progress. N - Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which Tenders are invited for 0.33 Years. B - Value at 2026-27 price level of existing commitments and ongoing works to be completed during the next 0.33 year period of completion of the works for which Tenders are invited

The Intending bidder in his name should have achieved in at least one financial year a minimum Financial Turnover (in all classes of civil engineering construction works only) of Rs.31.87 Lakhs (inclusive of GST) during the preceding five financial (i.e 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). The bidder shall submit certified copy of the turnover certificate duly certified by the chartered Accountant for the respective two years & the same shall be uploaded along with the technical bid. (Financial turnover of previous years shall be given weight at 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of financial year 2026-27)

technicalCriterionList.description: Any reputed individual/company registered KPWD Class-III and above contractor is eligible to apply and valid certificate issued in this regard shall be uploaded
The bidder shall belong to Schedule Tribe community as per Govt. of Karnataka. Valid Schedule Tribe certificate issued by Govt. of Karnataka shall be uploaded
The bidder shall be a domicile of the State of Karnataka for more than 10 years certified by Govt. of Karnataka. Valid Domicile certificate issued by Govt. of Karnataka shall be uploaded

The Bidders should upload the following declarations by duly signed, I/we shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by KPCL or by any State Government/Government of India/ Union Territory. I/we declares that EMD has not been forfeited and None of my contracts have been terminated/foreclosed on account of default in KPCL or elsewhere during the past 3 (Three) years. My/our offer has no conditions contravening the commercial conditions of the bid. I/we have studied the site conditions, labour conditions and read the Bid documents and related matters carefully and diligently and that he has submitted the bid having studied understood and accepted the full implications of the agreement. I/we shall pay fair and reasonable wages, which shall not be less than the minimum wages fixed by GOK to the labours/workmen employed in the contract. I/we have accepted the condition that KPCL reserves the right to foreclose the contract at any point of time without assigning any reason

itemList.description: Removal of Unserviceable Soil with Disposal upto a suitable distance as directed by the Engineer incharge of work

Dismantling of existing structures like culverts, bridges, retaining walls and other structure comprising of masonry, cement concrete, wood work, steel work, including T&P and scaffolding wherever necessary, sorting the dismantled material, disposal of unserviceable material and stacking the serviceable material with all lifts and lead. By Manual Means. Prestressed / Reinforced cement concrete grade M-20 & above

Earth work excavation for Foundation by mechanical means for all works & depth upto 3 m, as per drawing and technical specifications,including setting out, shoring, strutting, barricading, caution lights, including dressing of excavated surfaces, disposing off or levelling the excavated earth or sorting & stacking the selected earth for reuse in a radius of 50 m and lift upto 1.5 m including cost of labour, tools, usage of machinery & other appurtenaces required to complete the work of machinery & other appurtenaces required to complete the work. 1.14.1 In all kinds of soils Depth upto 3 m
Providing rubble and sand filling in layers of 250 to 300 mm including cost of all materials,machinery, labour, watering, ramming and all other ancillary operations complete

The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticisers, laid in layers, well compacted using needle vibrators, providing weep holes wherever necessary, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials of quality, confirming to the requirements of relevant IS codes, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing and all other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. M20 Design Mix Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates. M20 Design Mix Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates - FOR RAFT

M20 Design Mix Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates. M20 Design Mix Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates - FOR WALL

Supplying, fitting and placing TMT FE 550 / 550D Steel Reinforcement including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, cleaning, straightening,cutting, bending, hooking, laping/welding joints, tying with binding wire / soft annealed steel wire and other ancilary operations complete as per drawing and technical specification

Providing Random rubble masonry with hard stone in foundation and plinth including levelling up with cement concrete 1:6:12 (1 cement : 6 coarse sand : 12 graded stone aggregate 20 mm nominal size) upto plinth level with. Cement mortar 1:6 (1 cement : 6 coarse sand)

Providing 20 mm cement plaster of mix :1:4 (1 cement: 4 fine sand) to brick/stone masonary cluding rounding off corners wherever required smooth rendering, providing and removing scaffolding, including cost of materials, labour, curing complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge
